# owner: platform
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.notices import build_absence_notice

STUDENT = Student("1", "Lee", "Ana", "A")


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_days_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("1", date(2026, 3, 5), "absent"),
            Mark("1", date(2026, 3, 4), "present"),
            Mark("1", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")
        ]
        text = build_absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertEqual(
            text,
            "Ana Lee missed 2 day(s) of school: "
            "2026-03-02, 2026-03-05."
        )

    def test_other_student_is_rejected(self):
        marks = [Mark("2", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences_is_rejected(self):
        marks = [Mark("1", date(2026, 3, 2), "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
